scene_00_actors: Scene $00: empty list ($FF) and empty title ($CA). No actors, so no player is spawned.
scene_A7_actors: Scene $A7: the longest list (62 records, $00-$3D): player, camera, ScrollCameraInit, a dark_space and many ramps and speed zones (movement_speed_zones).
scene_actors: 256 word pointers, indexed by scene id ($00-$FF, SpawnSceneActors uses sceneTableIndex as a byte offset). Each points to a scene record (actor list + $FF + title). 16 ids share scene_default_actors, the others are unique.
scene_actors_extract_table: Generated by the extractor (Extract(1)), not present in the ROM: 256 pointers to the title strings, same indexing as scene_actors. The titles themselves sit directly after each list's $FF in the ROM.
scene_default_actors: Default record for the 16 unused scene ids: the player (tile 2,9, attribute $02), camera_scroll_controller and ScrollCameraTrack, title TEST MAP. Reached only if one of those ids is loaded; nothing found loads one.
scene_default_actors_value: Title of the default record. Visible only for the 16 unused ids; see scene_default_actors.
scene_F7_actors: Scene $F7 (credits): no PlayerCharacterDef; the first records are sF7_credits_player and five NPC actors (attribute $00, tile 18,1), then sF7_credits.
scene_FF_actors: Scene $FF (inventory menu): InventoryMenuDef at record $00 and six inventory_statue_slot actors (records $01-$06, odd attribute bytes $21 / $03 / $05 / $27 / $09 / $0B = spawn parameters $10 / 1 / 2 / $13 / 4 / 5). No player and no camera.
scene_thinkers: 256 word pointers, index = scene ID. An entry may point into the middle of a list (the +4 / +8 suffix is the byte offset), see the block note.
thinker_spawn_0CE7EA: Shared default list: ambient_palette_cycler (bundle $3F), flag_gated_palette_cool, scanline_band_hdma_thinker (band $02), global_ambient_dispatcher. Entered at +0 by 2 scenes, at +4 by 4 and at +8 by 43.
thinker_spawn_0CE8E6: Unreferenced by the table: scanline_band_hdma_thinker band $20 and global_ambient_dispatcher (OQ-I072-3).
thinker_spawn_0CE9EA: Unreferenced by the table: palette bundles $01 and $32, global_ambient_dispatcher and scanline band $0F (OQ-I072-3).
thinker_spawn_0CEA45: Unreferenced by the table: a copy of thinker_spawn_0CEA2F (bundles $44 and $45 and the dispatcher) (OQ-I072-3).
thinker_spawn_dispatcher_only: The bare list: only global_ambient_dispatcher. Used by 70 scenes.
